item.title: Match Report: Walsall 1-2 Shrewsbury Town
item.description: A high-pressure match saw Walsall unable to counter in an early lead and lose out to 10 men Shrewsbury Town, reports Izaak Darvill. The first chance of the game came Walsall’s way when the Saddlers capitalised well on a loose throw in. A threaded pass by Ellis Harris found Paul Makavore who raced into a one-on-one with goalkeeper Lewis Smart and he spread himself well to make the save. item.title: Match Report: Walsall 0-0 Crawley Town
item.description: Walsall picked up another point in their Sky Bet League Two campaign on Tuesday evening as they played out a goalless draw with Crawley Town at the Pallet-Track Bescot Stadium. It was back-to-back 0-0 draws for the Saddlers as they continued to occupy the playoff positions in the table. Mat Sadler made three changes to his side following the goalless draw on Saturday afternoon. item.title: Annual Gender Pay Gap Report
item.description: We have recently submitted our annual gender pay gap report as required under Government legislation. The data is available online through the Government portal. As we employ more than 250 full and part-time staff at the snapshot date, we must report our ‘Gender Pay Gap’ information as of 5th April 2025. item.title: New date confirmed for trip to Salford City
item.description: Due to Salford City's participation in the fourth round of the Emirates FA Cup, our trip to the Peninsula Stadium will now take place on Tuesday 10th March, kick-off 7.45pm. The fixture was originally scheduled for Saturday 14th February but has been moved as a result of their fixture against Manchester City taking place that day. Tickets for this fixture will go on sale from Monday 16th February, with full details on prices confirmed in due course.
